full_judgment: 11. It may be pointed out here that if these vital documents as filed in the case by the defendants would have been considered by the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division in affirming the decision of the lower appellate Court, then the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division would not have hesitated to hold that the presumption of correctness of the CS record as contained in Ext. 1 and l(a) had been amply rebutted, as the CS record was prepared during the period of 1913-16 and it did not represent correct position at all.
